definitions.explanation: A high-ranking military officer who commands a unit, base, or operation. Also used figuratively for leaders who direct large-scale operations.

examples.japanese: {司令官|しれいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{司令官|しれいかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指揮|しき}する→指揮する：21994_shikisuru⟧。
examples.english: To direct operations as supreme commander.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{司令官|しれいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着任|ちゃくにん}→着任：14905_chakunin⟧し、⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{士気|しき}→士気：19824_shiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まった→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: The new commander took up his post, and the troops' morale rose.

notes:
Composed of {司令|しれい} (command, directing) + {官|かん} (officer, official). A formal military title for the officer in charge of a unit or base.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{司令官|しれいかん}: supreme commander
- {司令官|しれいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint as commander
- {司令官|しれいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: the commander's order
- {総|そう}{司令官|しれいかん}: commander-in-chief

ETYMOLOGY:
{連合国軍最高司令官総司令部|れんごうこくぐんさいこうしれいかんそうしれいぶ} (GHQ/SCAP) was the headquarters of the Allied occupation of Japan after World War II, led by General MacArthur as ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{司令官|しれいかん}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{司令部|しれいぶ}→司令部：18450_shireibu⟧: headquarters, command center
- ⟦{指揮官|しきかん}→指揮官：19069_shikikan⟧: commanding officer — more general term for someone who directs
- ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧: general — a military rank
